svg.title: The calibration fibre. The bottom-coupling map BN,p : [aN,p, bN,p] →[3 ̄β/4, 5 ̄β/4], b 7→ β(R b N,p,0), is a continuous surjective readout of the bare parameter. At this point of the argument nothing makes this fibre a single point: no uniqueness of an inverse shooting map is assumed, and existence used only the intermediate value theorem.
